To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the best results are achieved with the strategy using CF-IDF profiling, sliding window, full-texts.

(i) HCF-IDF is an effective profiling method that achieves good results when just the titles are used for recommendation; (ii) CF-IDF is a more effective profiling method than topic modeling; (iii) sliding window is a more effective temporal decay method than exponential decay; (iv) using the full-texts is a more effective method than using just titles; and (v) the performance of the recommendation strategies is stable over time.
the novel HCFIDF method outperforms the other profiling methods and that the use of the titles of publications is sufficient.
